verdict.line: You lose if you let him land Q (Seismic Shard) and W (Brutal Strikes) stacks for free while you stand in range; you win if you punish his E (Ground Slam) cooldown and force trades off cooldown.

brief.thesis: This is a 46.3% matchup over 2,355 games with an even overall shape — neither side has a structural lane advantage. Darius's trade pattern depends on landing E (Apprehend) pulls to stack Hemorrhage, but Malphite's passive (Granite Shield) absorbs a chunk of the first hit in any trade if he hasn't been poked recently, so your damage output is softened unless you're already chipping him with ranged pressure or back-to-back hits.

theirWindow.when: His E (Ground Slam) is up, Granite Shield charged
theirWindow.what: He can walk up, shockwave you for armor-scaled magic damage, slow your attack speed, and shield the return trade. Don't extend auto-trades into this window — back off and wait it out.

yourWindow.when: His E (Ground Slam) just went down, 7s cooldown
yourWindow.what: This is your trade window. Walk up, land E (Apprehend) to pull and ignore a percentage of his Armor, then W (Crippling Strike) and stack Hemorrhage freely since he has no shockwave or attack-speed reduction to answer with.

boots.why: 60.9% pick rate at 47.7% win rate; the magic resist directly answers his E (Ground Slam) and R (Unstoppable Force) magic damage, both of which scale off his own Armor stacking from W.

runes.keystoneWhy: 47.4% win rate at 27.4% pick; the stacking adaptive force and healing on takedown reward exactly the extended trade windows you get after his E (Ground Slam) goes down, since Conqueror ramps the longer the fight runs.

summoners.why: 46.9% win rate at 76.4% pick, the most common page; Ghost closes the gap onto Malphite during his E cooldown window and chases down his only escape, R (Unstoppable Force), after he burns it offensively.

playing.title: Trade only off his E cooldown
playing.detail: Track his E (Ground Slam), 7s cooldown. Walking up while it's available eats a shockwave and an attack-speed slow for free — wait it out.

playing.title: Poke before you all-in
playing.detail: Granite Shield recharges if he hasn't been hit recently. Land a Q (Decimate) or auto first so your real trade isn't absorbed by his passive shield.

playing.title: Pull with E before he commits to W
playing.detail: E (Apprehend) hooks him in and ignores a percentage of his Armor passively. Use it the instant his Ground Slam is down so he can't answer with the Brutal Strikes armor spike in time.

playing.title: Hold R for stacked Hemorrhage
playing.detail: R (Noxian Guillotine) scales with Hemorrhage stacks and deals true damage. Stack bleeds with Q and W first so your execute threshold is lower than his remaining HP.

playing.title: Respect his R past level 11
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force knocks you airborne and deals damage from up to 1000 range. Don't overextend past minion lines once he's 11+, since this is a long-range engage you can't out-position reactively.

playing.title: Use Ghost to punish his lack of escape
playing.detail: Malphite has no mobility outside his 1000-range R. If he burns it to engage and whiffs or trades badly, Ghost lets you run him down before his next R is up (115-100-80s at ranks 2-4).

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoner spells, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the tactical reading of cooldown windows and trade timing is my own analysis layered on top of the ability text.
